status: Frozen before any inference for this added cohort analysis; exploratory only.
reason: The user requested a sequence-matched comparison on PolypGen seq1–seq21 excluding seq1 and seq7, so that current memory-writer conditions can be compared with native SAM2 over the same cohort.
interpretation_limit: This cohort mixes training, validation, and six sequences from the parent protocol's test split. Because sequences 2–15 informed training or checkpoint selection, and seq16–21 are included in this post-hoc extension, the aggregate is descriptive and exploratory, not a held-out or independent confirmation. Do not claim generalization or publishability from this analysis alone.

conditions.native_sam2: Fresh SAM2.1 Tiny propagation using the checkpoint, prompt convention, sequence inputs, post-processing, and evaluation code pinned by attempt_05.
conditions.mask_neutral_writer: The completed attempt_05 capacity/training-matched neutral writer, using its best checkpoint selected only on the parent protocol's seq13–15 validation set.
conditions.soft_mask_writer: The completed attempt_05 soft-mask-conditioned writer, using its best checkpoint selected only on the parent protocol's seq13–15 validation set. Do not evaluate until its training and checkpoint integrity are complete.

controls: Run all three conditions freshly through the same evaluator and exact 19 sequences; do not substitute historical scores from a different checkpoint, prompt rule, resolution, or protocol.
Initialize a fresh predictor for every condition-sequence pair to avoid state leakage.
Do not alter training, select checkpoints, tune thresholds, or change the method based on any output from this cohort evaluation.

Keep the parent protocol's validation-gate result and its original test-split result record distinct. This amendment authorizes only a descriptive full-cohort analysis; it does not retroactively turn the mixed cohort into a confirmatory test.
metrics: Per-sequence post-prompt present-frame Dice, IoU, and boundary F.

Re-detection after annotated absence, using the existing propagation summary definition.
Equal-sequence means, paired differences against native SAM2 and the matched control, sequence-bootstrap intervals, paired tests with Holm adjustment, and leave-one-sequence-out sensitivity.

launch_condition: Wait until both writer arms have completed and their best-checkpoint hashes are recorded. Freeze their hashes and the actual evaluation script hash in the Drive setup receipt before the first full-cohort inference.
